name: benmi-desktop-pos
description: Benmi Multi-Tenant Universal Desktop POS App for Windows & macOS (Tauri v2 + Shared Rust Printer Core)

scripts.dev: APP_ENV=local bash build.sh && npx tauri dev
scripts.dev:remote: APP_ENV=prod bash build.sh && npx tauri dev
scripts.build: APP_ENV=prod bash build.sh && npx tauri build
scripts.build:dev: APP_ENV=dev bash build.sh && npx tauri build
scripts.build:staging: APP_ENV=staging bash build.sh && npx tauri build
scripts.build:local: APP_ENV=local bash build.sh && npx tauri build
scripts.build:mac: APP_ENV=prod bash build.sh && npx tauri build --bundles app && bash package-dmg.sh
scripts.build:mac:local: APP_ENV=local bash build.sh && npx tauri build --bundles app && bash package-dmg.sh
scripts.build:win: APP_ENV=prod bash build.sh && npx tauri build --bundles msi,nsis
